title: Seek first the Kingdom.
paragraphs:
Seek first the Kingdom.
Not your image.
Not your timeline.
Not the applause of people who can’t save your soul.
Jesus said it plain: “But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.” (Matthew 6:33)

That means God is not asking for leftovers.
Not the last five minutes of your day.
Not the corner of your heart you haven’t given to lust, fear, ambition, or control.

And here’s the hard part: we often want the benefits of the Kingdom without surrendering to the King.
We want provision without obedience.
Peace without repentance.
Blessing without bowing.
But here’s where grace walks in.

Jesus is not merely telling you to try harder.
He is calling you closer.
The same Christ who said “seek first” is the same Christ who went to the cross for every divided affection, every anxious thought, every heart that chased the world and came back empty.

So today, come back.
Put the King back on the throne of your heart.
Seek His rule. Seek His righteousness. Seek His face before everything else.
And trust this: when Christ is first, nothing truly needed is lost.

Prayer:
Lord Jesus, forgive me for putting lesser things above You. Teach me to seek Your Kingdom first, to hunger for righteousness, and to trust You with everything else. Amen.
